title: Efficient Inference for Large Reasoning Models: A Survey
paper_type_zh: 大推理模型高效推理综述
best_for_zh: 在内存、延迟或 token 预算下优化长推理过程的读者。
one_line: An NUS-led survey of efficient inference methods for long reasoning models.
把高效推理分为显式紧凑过程和隐式潜在过程的 NUS 综述。
why: It separates reducing visible tokens from preserving the information needed for correct reasoning.
inclusion_reason: A 2025 survey from NUS and collaborators that directly compares reasoning representation, test-time cost, and quality.

title: Problem
问题
html: Large reasoning models often improve answers by producing long chains of thought, but those chains consume tokens, memory, and time. This survey studies how to reduce that cost without confusing a shorter output with a better solution. Its core data objects are the prompt, reasoning representation, final answer, and a resource measurement.
大推理模型常通过输出长思维链提升答案，但这些过程消耗 token、内存和时间。该综述研究如何降低成本，而不把更短输出误认为更好解法。核心数据对象是提示、推理表示、最终答案和资源测量。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper separates explicit compact reasoning from implicit latent reasoning. The first keeps visible steps but tries to make them shorter; the second stores more computation in hidden representations. This distinction is useful because the two options trade different things: token cost, controllability, and the ability to inspect an intermediate argument.
论文区分显式紧凑推理和隐式潜在推理。前者保留可见步骤但试图缩短它们；后者把更多计算放进隐藏表示。两者的取舍不同：token 成本、可控性和检查中间论证的能力。

title: Method
方法
html: This is a taxonomy and empirical synthesis. For each primary method, record whether reasoning remains explicit, what is compressed or latent, the input allocation rule, model and decoding conditions, task score, token count, memory, and latency. A comparison is meaningful only when quality and resource measurements use the same task conditions.
这是分类与经验综合。对每个原始方法记录过程是否仍显式、什么被压缩或潜在化、输入分配规则、模型与解码条件、任务分数、token 数、内存和延迟。只有质量与资源测量使用相同任务条件，比较才有意义。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official abstract explicitly names the two reasoning categories and reports analysis from performance and efficiency perspectives. It supports a structured literature map, not a universal winner. Reported gains can depend on task difficulty, hardware, batching, context length, and whether a verifier is available.
官方摘要明确命名两类推理，并从性能与效率角度分析。它支持结构化文献地图，而不是普遍赢家。报告的提升可能依赖任务难度、硬件、批处理、上下文长度，以及是否存在验证器。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The contribution is to center reasoning representation rather than generic model serving. It connects compact visible traces, latent computation, model merging, and architectural changes to the same resource question. The paper does not claim that internal latent computation is always preferable; visibility can be essential when a task needs human review or step checking.
贡献在于把推理表示而非一般模型服务放到中心。它把紧凑可见过程、潜在计算、模型合并和架构变化连接到同一资源问题。论文不主张隐藏推理总是更好；当任务需要人工查看或逐步检查时，可见性可能必不可少。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Efficiency has no single unit. Reducing visible tokens may raise hidden compute, and a lower latency result on one server may not transfer to another. Latent reasoning also makes error diagnosis harder. Before reuse, inspect the benchmark, budget definition, and cases where compression changed a correct answer into an incorrect one.
效率没有单一单位。减少可见 token 可能增加隐藏计算；某服务器上的低延迟也未必迁移到另一服务器。潜在推理还会使错误诊断更难。复用前应检查基准、预算定义，以及压缩把正确答案改成错误答案的案例。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this survey when choosing how a reasoning system should meet a budget. First decide whether intermediate steps must be inspectable. Then compare explicit shortening, latent approaches, and adaptive allocation with the same answer-quality floor. This prevents an engineering choice from silently changing what the system is able to show or justify.
当为推理系统选择预算方案时，可用这篇综述。先决定中间步骤是否必须可检查；再以相同答案质量下限比较显式缩短、潜在方法和自适应分配。这能避免工程选择悄悄改变系统能够展示或说明的内容。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the explicit-versus-latent distinction first. For each method, keep a row for quality, visible trace, hidden compute, memory, latency, and failure case. The practical lesson is that efficient reasoning is a multi-objective design problem: one favorable number cannot stand in for all the other columns.
先读显式与潜在的区别。对每个方法保留一行：质量、可见过程、隐藏计算、内存、延迟和失败案例。实用结论是高效推理是多目标设计问题：一个漂亮数字不能代替其他所有列。
